# Message Types in the Vercel AI SDK
## Key points [#](https://www.joyehuang.me/en/notes/0426-vercel-ai-sdk-message-types#key-points)
### 2. `UIMessage` is the source of truth in the frontend [#](https://www.joyehuang.me/en/notes/0426-vercel-ai-sdk-message-types#2-uimessage-is-the-source-of-truth-in-the-frontend)
- `reasoning`
- `tool-${name}`
- `source-document`
- `file`
- `data-${name}`

- the input/output lifecycle of a tool call
- custom data blocks

### 5. The `tool-${name}` part is a key design point of AI SDK UI [#](https://www.joyehuang.me/en/notes/0426-vercel-ai-sdk-message-types#5-the-tool-name-part-is-a-key-design-point-of-ai-sdk-ui)
This is far better than “the assistant sends a line of text + the frontend guesses which stage we’re in right now.”

Its significance is that:

- tool UI can be aligned directly with a state machine
- loading / success / error can be modeled uniformly
- it’s easier to render stably even when multiple tools run concurrently
- tool input and output can become part of the message history directly

This is really a key step in AI chat UIs evolving from “text bubbles” into “structured interaction records.”

### 10. This shows `UIMessage` isn’t a static data structure but a protocol endpoint [#](https://www.joyehuang.me/en/notes/0426-vercel-ai-sdk-message-types#10-this-shows-uimessage-isnt-a-static-data-structure-but-a-protocol-endpoint)
- all the text / reasoning / tool / source / file events

## Current understanding / conclusions [#](https://www.joyehuang.me/en/notes/0426-vercel-ai-sdk-message-types#current-understanding--conclusions)
### 3. For agent / tool-heavy apps, `parts` is closer to the future than plain `content: string` [#](https://www.joyehuang.me/en/notes/0426-vercel-ai-sdk-message-types#3-for-agent--tool-heavy-apps-parts-is-closer-to-the-future-than-plain-content-string)
- reasoning fragments
- file / data parts

## To be added [#](https://www.joyehuang.me/en/notes/0426-vercel-ai-sdk-message-types#to-be-added)
3. How to break the `tool-${name}` part into components in a complex tool UI
